findings.desc: Existing regression smokes were not updated for delivery-check materialHash binding. Repro: `node packages/main/dist/tasks/flow-stability-smoke.js` fails because the synthetic docsPromise delivery-check at packages/main/src/tasks/flow-stability-smoke.ts:3966 signs without materialHash, so DONE reports `stale delivery-check: delivery-check.json is missing materialHash binding` before the expected docsPromise failure. Additional repros: `node packages/main/dist/tasks/lifecycle-check-smoke.js`, `node packages/main/dist/tasks/review-assurance-floor-smoke.js`, and `node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-preflight-smoke.js` also fail from legacy delivery-check fixtures. Update these fixtures/helpers to record headHash/materialHash and sign with materialHash where they intend a fresh delivery-check, or adjust assertions where stale legacy evidence is intentional.
